key_points: Meta Connect showcased Muse AI agent and new hardware, positioning it as a growth catalyst.
Multiple analysts (JPMorgan, BofA, Morgan Stanley, William Blair) raised price targets or reiterated buy/overweight ratings.
Market reaction positive: stock rose to 52‑week highs, with optimism on AI revenue expansion.
Some skeptics (Barron's, Gene Munster) note execution risk and possible flop of hardware device.
Impact expected over the next few weeks as Muse adoption metrics and hardware sales materialize.
